title: Mirage Maintenance
description: Extrapolate sequences forward and backward using iterated differences.
writeup:
## Approach

This is Newton's forward difference method. For each sequence, repeatedly take pairwise differences to form a pyramid of layers. A polynomial of degree `d` produces all zeros by the `d`-th layer, which gives the base case for extrapolation.

## Part 1

Extrapolate forward by summing the last element of every layer. Each layer's last value contributes one term to the next value of the original sequence.

## Part 2

Extrapolate backward using the first elements instead. Work from the all-zeros layer upward: at each level, the new leftmost value is `first_element - value_below`. The alternating subtraction is what distinguishes backward from forward extrapolation.
